messages:
maria: heads-up — CI microbench on PR #20245 tripped the perf gate. perf-bot posted a threshold diff. KV hit-rate and tail latency look bad :sob:

perf-bot: REGRESSION DETECTED for pr/20245
  metric: kv_hit_rate
  baseline: 0.86
  pr: 0.42
  delta: -0.44 (-51%)
  p99_latency_tokens: baseline 34.2ms -> pr 38.6ms (+12.8%)
  tokens_per_sec: 220k -> 170k (-22.7%)
  artifacts: https://ci.example.com/artifacts/pr-20245/bench-4987654322

sam: linking bisect output: https://ci.example.com/bisect/4987654322 — perf-bot suggests a likely commit range. :eyes:

perf-bot: probable culprit commit: 1a2b3c4 (author: kevin)
  title: "batching: prefer-affinity weighting change; kernel-autoselect tweak"
  confidence: medium (3/5)

kevin: I pushed that tweak yesterday to bias kernel selection toward affinity when batch fullness low. I didn't expect KV hit-rate to change — curious.

maria: can you reproduce locally? assign owners: @sam for bisect followup, @kevin to triage kernel selector change. Holding merge and staging rollout until triage. :hammer_and_wrench:

sam: quick local run (dockerized bench) — I can repro the drop. Minimal summary:
```
# bench-summary
kv_hit_rate: baseline 0.86 -> pr 0.43
p99_latency_ms: 33.9 -> 39.1
median_batch_size: 6.2 -> 3.1
kernel_choice_distribution:
  quant_fast: 72% -> 28%
  generic_autoselect: 18% -> 60%
  fallback_small: 10% -> 12%
```
Looks like more requests are getting routed to the generic_autoselect path, which increases token work and evicts KV entries more aggressively.

kevin: digging into commit 1a2b3c4 — I changed prefer_affinity weight from 0.8 to 0.2 in kernel_selector.cc to reduce hotpath stalls. Patch excerpt:
```
- if (seq_affinity_score * 0.8 > cost_score) choose_affinity();
+ if (seq_affinity_score * 0.2 > cost_score) choose_affinity();
```
That will favor non-affinity kernels more often, could explain smaller batches and worse KV locality. I can prepare a patch to revert that constant.

jen: this is blocking the release runway. what's the rollback plan?

maria: plan proposal:
  1) @sam open a revert PR for 1a2b3c4 against main and staging (revert-only).
  2) run full microbench CI + smoke deck on staging, if green, merge revert and resume rollout.
  3) @kevin to prepare a unit-tested variant that restores affinity weighting but adds a safety threshold (only change when seq_len < 32) and run bench.
  4) add a golden test to perf-suite that asserts kv_hit_rate >= 0.8 for the canonical chat trace.

ops-bot: rollback ticket created: RB-20245-498765 — revert-pr-20245-revert-1 queued.

sam: opened revert PR: https://git.example.com/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/20246 — trigger CI now.

kevin: I'm also adding extra telemetry to kernel-selector to emit kernel_choice and seq_affinity_score per route to make root-cause clearer. small patch coming.

maria: thanks. timeline: if revert CI is green within 2 hours we roll back. if not, we escalate to hotfix call. Keep updates here — post any flamegraphs or heap profiles.

sam: quick flamegraph I captured locally — shows big spike in generic_autoselect::dispatch and heavy memcopy churn during KV misses:
```
flame 1000ms
|--generic_autoselect::dispatch 45%\n|  |--quant_conv_kernel 12%\n|  \--kv_lookup_miss_handler 18%\n|--kernel_selector::score 8%\n|--io_wait 4%\n```

kevin: ack. patch for telemetry + temp revert test prepared. will push when revert CI finishes.

maria: solid. if anyone sees other surprising deltas (batch size, warmup hit patterns), paste logs. tagging @ops on-call if we need infra rollback. :triage_flag:

jen: noted — prepping release notes hold.

(reacts: maria :thumbsup:, sam :eyes:, kevin :pray:)
